verdict.rationale: cfo.ai's in-product agent Ari could plausibly act as an MCP client, so this axis applies. However, the evidence documents only the opposite role: cfo.ai exposes its own MCP server for external clients like Claude Code and Codex. Nothing shows users adding third-party MCP servers for Ari to use, and the per-tool allow/ask/deny policy has no stated link to consuming external MCP tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
